user.title: SEQ Thunderstorm Tracker
user.description: Storm positions come from the Bureau of Meteorology's Thunderstorm Tracker (Southeast Queensland pilot). Home Assistant does not fetch them itself: a small userscript in your browser sends them while a bom.gov.au tab is open. You get its address on the next screen.

data_description.targets: Zones, people or device trackers. Each gets its own distance sensors and map.
data_description.radius_km: A storm closer than this turns on the place's "Storm nearby" sensor and is drawn as a ring on its map.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already set up. Use Configure to change it.

data_description.stale_minutes: When nothing newer has arrived, the sensors become unavailable instead of showing old storms or clear skies. The tracker updates about every 6 minutes.
